source: Community-sourced from MLB.com, ESPN, USA Today, Dodgers Nation, Dodgers Blue, ClutchPoints, The Athletic, Braves reporting, @MarkBowmanBSB

ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.details: Suffered a non-displaced fracture of the left fibula during Spring Training 2026. Missed virtually the entire 2025 season and extended into early 2026. On 60-day injured list while rehabbing. This is his first injury-shortened season since 2023. NOT cleared for cutting drills yet. Must progress: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting → MiLB rehab → MLB activation.

injury_history.details: Non-displaced fracture sustained in Spring Training 2026. Currently on 60-day IL rehabbing. Not cleared for cutting drills.
Hobbled after scoring. 10-day IL, missed 2-3 weeks. Initial diagnosis was Achilles, MRI confirmed calf strain.
Strained the medial collateral ligament in his left knee during a game. Missed time but returned.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Faced long-term concerns about his clutch-play dominance returning.
Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

rehab_timeline.progress: Cleared for BP, throwing, straight-line drills. NOT cleared for cutting drills.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023. Acuña's return timeline is still uncertain. Community contributors should monitor Braves beat reporters (Journal Sentinel, MLB.com, @MarkBowmanBSB) for Rehab Gate updates. The fibula fracture adds to a well-documented history of knee issues. Must progress through: BP → live pitching → straight-line running → cutting drills → MiLB rehab → MLB activation.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.type: Stiff lower back (Jul 11) + Right wrist soreness (resolved Jul 2)
current_injury.details: Stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses (out 3+ games). NOT expected on IL. Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.' Right wrist soreness before loss to A's improved after treatment. Earlier (Jul 1): Right oblique strain caused lineup removal, returned shortly after. On 7-game hitting streak with .355 avg over last 15 games.
current_injury.rehab_timeline: Within days (day-to-day management). No IL expected for either issue.

injury_history.details: Stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses. Out 3+ games. Not on IL.
Before loss to A's. Improved after treatment. Roberts: 'Betts wrist is feeling better.' Returned next day.
Lineup removal from game on Jul 1. Roberts optimistic. Returned to lineup shortly after.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (~20 lbs in two weeks). Death of stepfather.
Broken right wrist during batting practice in a freak spring training accident at Camelback Ranch. Struck by deflected ball from pitching machine. Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
DL stint. Roberts optimistic. Returned to lineup.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management.

rehab_timeline.notes: Conservative treatment. Not activated even when symptom-free. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected for back or wrist.

mookie-betts.return_status: Day-to-Day - Symptom-free, no IL expected. Recurring issues possible.
mookie-betts.notes: Betts' 2025-2026 has been tumultuous — broken wrist, oblique strain (x2), severe illness, personal loss, and recurring back/wrist issues. All major injuries have resolved. On a 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15 games). Community should update if recurring issues worsen. The pitching machine freak accident remains one of the more bizarre in baseball history.

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.type: Neck stinger (resolved Aug 2025); Chronic left ankle managed
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently reported. Neck stinger from August 2025 fully resolved. Managing chronic left ankle with occasional flare-ups. Left rib/scar tissue re-aggravated Mar 2025 (Tokyo Dome). Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo vs Cubs.
current_injury.rehab_timeline: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment.

injury_history.details: Scratched from lineup vs Cincinnati Reds. Stinger from neck into right shoulder. Returned Friday with lingering effects per Roberts.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management.
Re-aggravated during BP before Tokyo Dome debut. Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo. Roberts: 'thought was scar tissue broke up during BP.'
Ongoing neck management after August stinger.
Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement + loose body removal (Dec 2024). Played through in 2024 postseason (Walk-Off Grand Slam).

rehab_timeline.notes: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment. Off days expected to help manage neck stinger effects.

freddie-freeman.return_status: N/A - Currently active and playing regularly. Neck stinger resolved, chronic ankle under management.
freddie-freeman.notes: Freeman's chronic ankle issues (both right and left) require ongoing monitoring, especially as a first baseman placing heavy stress on lower extremities. Previous left ankle sprain in June 2025 and right ankle debridement in Dec 2024 suggest a trend. Freeman's walk-off Grand Slam in 2024 World Series cemented his legend despite injury challenges. Community should track Dodgers beat reporters for any lineup changes.
